en.title: Sterilisers
en.summary: The autoclaves and dry-heat ovens at each branch, which sterilisation cycles are recorded against.

sections.heading: One row a machine
sections.body: Give each steriliser a name staff recognise — the one on its sticker — its kind, its serial number for the service engineer, and the branch it stands in. Cycles are numbered per machine, on from its last.

sections.heading: Retiring one
sections.body: Set it Inactive when it is replaced. Its cycles stay in the log.

am.title: ማምከኛ ማሽኖች
am.summary: በእያንዳንዱ ቅርንጫፍ ያሉ አውቶክሌቮችና ደረቅ ሙቀት ምድጃዎች።

sections.heading: ለአንድ ማሽን አንድ መስመር
sections.body: ለእያንዳንዱ ማሽን ሠራተኞች የሚያውቁትን ስም፣ ዓይነቱን፣ የሴሪያል ቁጥሩንና ያለበትን ቅርንጫፍ ይስጡ። ዙሮች በማሽን ይቆጠራሉ።

sections.heading: ማቆም
sections.body: ሲተካ Inactive ያድርጉት። ዙሮቹ በመዝገቡ ውስጥ ይቀራሉ።
